is_fee_on_transfer_token.meaning: the deposited token deducts a percentage fee on each transfer

deposit_amount.meaning: amount parameter passed to increaseTokenBalance() by the depositing user

tokens_actually_received.meaning: tokens actually received by the contract after the fee-on-transfer deduction
tokens_actually_received.checkpoint: after token transfer into contract, before balance credit

credited_balance.meaning: creatorBalance credited to the user by increaseTokenBalance()

actual_holdings.meaning: actual token holdings of the contract after the deposit

assumptions: increaseTokenBalance() is callable by the depositing user without additional authorization requirements (report does not state a caller restriction).
The 1% fee example (10,000 deposited, 9,900 received) is the representative scenario for the fee-on-transfer deduction.

unresolved.description: Report does not state who may call increaseTokenBalance() or any authorization requirement; the deposit scenario is treated as user-initiated.

limitations: Only the balance_inflation impact is formalized; protocol insolvency, last-withdrawer loss, and campaign funding failures are separate impacts not covered by this plan.
The quantified_deficit assumption (1,000,000 deposited, 10,000 deficit, last ~1% unable to withdraw) is a potential example and is not encoded as a precondition of this claim.

credited_balance and actual_holdings are declared as distinct post-credit observables; the report's 'recorded balances permanently exceed actual holdings' is captured by the relation credited_balance <= tokens_actually_received being violated.
